Headquarters: UK - Remote

About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 
Ping is continuing its significant global expansion, and we need a key member to join our UK Finance team to help prepare the organization and the Controllership function for scale. As a Finance Assistant, you'll be instrumental in ensuring the efficiency and accuracy of our core operational finance processes, providing a platform for continued success and personal growth.

If you are detail-oriented, love process improvement, and want to see your work directly support a massive growth trajectory, this is the place for you.

What You Will Do: Key Responsibilities

You will manage critical daily financial operations while contributing to system and process improvements across the UK and global operations.

Accounts Payable (AP) & Vendor Management

• Process Efficiency: Accurately enter and process Accounts Payable (AP) vendor invoices from our global operations.

• Payment & Control: Assist with the preparation of global payment runs and actively monitor the AP inbox to ensure timely processing and issue resolution.

• Risk Mitigation: Strictly maintain vendor onboarding controls and bank change validations to mitigate the risk of financial fraud.

• Dispute Resolution: Research and resolve discrepancies arising from vendor disputes, payment differences, and invoice reconciliations, ensuring high vendor satisfaction.

• Internal Service: Provide excellent customer service to internal company departments involved in the end-to-end AP process.

Travel & Expense (T&E) Administration

• Policy Compliance: Review and verify employee travel and business expenses, ensuring strict alignment with Ping’s global Travel & Expense policy.

• Employee Experience: Assist with T&E queries, ensuring timely responses.

Accounting & Operational Excellence

• Complete weekly cash flow forecast covering planned AP and expense payments.

• Complete reconciliations of actual payments vs forecast on a weekly basis.

• Build future medium term AP and expense payments forecasts supporting company cash flow forecasting.

What You Bring: Qualifications

Essential Experience & Skills

• 3+ years of experience in an Accounts Payable (AP) or operational Procurement role, preferably within a global or multi-entity environment.

• Proven experience with employee expense policy verification and processing.

• Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

• A collaborative personality with outstanding verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Experience

• Direct experience with major financial systems (e.g., Coupa, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite).

• Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, data manipulation).

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

• A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.

• Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.

• Regular company and team bonding events.

• Competitive benefits and perks.

• Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

• Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 

• Parental Leave

• Progressive Healthcare Options

• Retirement Programs

• Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 

• Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-business-services-assistant

Role: Equity Research Analyst (Australian Process)
Company: V2U Consultancy Services Pvt. Ltd. (V2U Research)
Location: Noida, Sector 2 (Work from Office)
aloshy@v2uconsultancy.com

Company Description
V2U Research is embracing the global vision of our team to provide data driven and authentic general financial advice to our customers. V2U research is able to utilize its experience with data, technology and global markets to offer TSX listed securities recommendations for our Australian clients. V2UResearch Inc is an independent equities research firm that provides quality, unbiased &timely updates around buying, selling, or holding of stocks. Our goal is to provide you with the best market intelligence at the right time, at the right price.

Position Summary
We are looking for an Equity Research Analyst with a strong interest and understanding of equity markets, fundamental and technical analysis. The candidate will support company and industry research, analyze financial and market data, assist with valuations and financial models, and contribute to equity research reports and investment insights.

Key Responsibilities
• Equity Research & Fundamental Analysis: Research companies and industries by analyzing financial statements, company performance, industry trends, business fundamentals, growth prospects, and key risks.
• Technical Analysis: Analyze stock price movements, market trends, trading volumes, chart patterns, support and resistance levels, and relevant technical indicators.
• Financial Modeling & Valuation: Assist in building and maintaining financial models and performing company valuation and financial analysis.
• Market Research: Track equity markets, company announcements, financial results, industry developments, and other market-moving information.
• Investment Analysis: Identify potential investment opportunities and risks by combining fundamental and technical analysis.
• Research Reporting: Prepare company updates, research notes, equity research reports, market commentary, and presentations.
• Team Collaboration: Work closely with senior analysts and the research team to support ongoing research assignments.

Qualifications & Requirements
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, or a related field.
• CFA Level 1 cleared – Mandatory.
• 1–3 years of relevant experience in Equity Research, Investment Research, Financial Analysis, or a related field. We are not looking for freshers.
• Strong understanding of fundamental and technical analysis.
• Basic to good understanding of financial statements, financial modeling, and company valuation.
• Proficiency in MS Excel.
• Strong analytical and research skills with attention to detail.
• Good written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong interest in equity markets and investment research.
• Exposure to Australian or global equity markets is mandatory.

Additional Info: Shift Timing: 05:15 AM to 02:30 PM
Working Days: Monday - Friday - Work from office
Week Off: Saturday and Sunday
Salary: 35-40K per month in hand (not negotiable)
One way pick-up cab service available for certain location in the Delhi NCR(not Gurugram)
We're NOT looking for candidates who're residing outside Delhi NCR
aloshy@v2uconsultancy.com

Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
What’s the opportunity?

As a Principal Customer Success Manager, you’ll partner with some of our largest and most complex enterprise customers to help them transform customer service with AI. You’ll work with executive sponsors, Support leaders, and cross-functional teams to connect Fin’s capabilities to business priorities and guide customers from strategy and implementation through adoption, measurable value, and renewal.

You’ll own the success strategy for a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers, navigating complex organizations, multiple stakeholder groups, and evolving business needs. This is an opportunity to advise senior leaders, influence how global businesses deploy AI, and help shape the playbooks and best practices for our growing Customer Success team.

Responsibilities

• Own the health, success strategy, and retention of a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers, partnering closely with Account Management on renewal plans.

• Build relationships across executive sponsors, operational leaders, technical teams, and frontline users. Develop multi-threaded stakeholder maps and ensure alignment across decision-makers and teams.

• Lead executive conversations, strategic planning, QBRs/EBRs, and success-plan reviews that connect Fin’s roadmap and performance to customers’ business priorities.

• Drive measurable value realization by tying Fin’s outcomes to customer goals such as cost savings, team capacity, customer experience, and service quality. Make progress and ROI clear to executive sponsors.

• Develop and prioritize customer-specific AI and automation roadmaps, aligning business objectives, operational readiness, technical dependencies, and measurable milestones.

• Guide complex enterprise implementations and adoption programs, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and documentation of workflows across teams, systems, or regions.

• Partner with Solutions Engineering, Product, Support, and other internal teams to translate customer requirements into effective Fin solution designs. Advise on configuration, knowledge strategy, integrations, and prompt design.

• Monitor leading indicators such as Fin resolution rate, involvement, CSAT, adoption breadth, and stakeholder engagement. Identify risks early and lead mitigation plans that protect customer outcomes and renewals.

• Analyze usage and performance data to identify optimization opportunities, close resolution gaps, and uncover expansion use cases.

• Maintain deep knowledge of Fin’s evolving capabilities and the AI-agent market, using that expertise to advise customers and position solutions against alternatives.

• Represent the Voice of the Customer internally, translating enterprise customer needs into actionable product feedback and influencing our solutions strategy.

• Mentor other CSMs and contribute to the playbooks, operating practices, and standards of a growing enterprise Customer Success team.

What skills do I need?

• 8+ years of customer-facing experience in enterprise Customer Success, strategic account management, management consulting, strategy, or a related advisory role.

• Demonstrated experience working with large enterprise clients, including complex organizations, senior stakeholders, and multi-team or cross-functional programs.

• A track record of building executive relationships and influencing decisions across a range of customer stakeholders, from C-suite leaders to operational and technical teams.

• Demonstrated success driving adoption, retention, process improvement, and measurable business outcomes for enterprise customers.

• Experience with business process mapping, requirements analysis, solution design, or complex technology implementations.

• Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect product performance and customer outcomes to ROI, renewal strategy, and expansion opportunities.

• Strong technical acumen and a genuine interest in AI, automation, and agent-building. Coding experience is not required.

• Ability to simplify complex problems and communicate clearly with both executive and technical audiences.

• Excellent prioritization and program-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities across a strategic customer portfolio.

• Self-motivated, adaptable, and curious, with the judgment and ownership to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment.

• A collaborative team player who can influence across functions, advocate for customers, and help elevate the work of the broader team.

Headquarters: United States | Remote

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.
The Team: 

Upstart's Bank Secrecy Act/Anti-Money Laundering Compliance team is responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing the company's enterprise BSA/AML Program, Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), sanctions, and suspicious activity compliance programs. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal, Fraud, and Enterprise Risk to ensure our products and services are built on a strong foundation of regulatory compliance and effective risk management. We build scalable, risk-based programs that evolve alongside our products and regulatory expectations.

As the Compliance Manager, BSA/AML Program at Upstart, you will serve as a BSA/AML subject matter expert for Upstart Bank’s secured and unsecured lending products and support the development of new deposit products. Using a risk-based approach, you will evaluate changes to identify risks, develop controls, and measure ongoing performance of changes to ensure products and services are implemented within a strong compliance framework.

How you’ll make an impact

• Lead the design, execution, and continuous improvement of BSA/AML, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), transaction monitoring, and sanctions screening processes for secured lending, unsecured lending, and deposit account products.

• Serve as a BSA/AML Compliance advisor for deposit product initiatives, partnering with Product, Legal, Operations, Engineering, and Enterprise Risk throughout product development and implementation.

• Develop and manage BSA/AML compliance initiatives, including new deposit product launches, regulatory enhancements, and control improvements.

• Administer ongoing customer due diligence and enhanced due diligence programs for deposit accounts in alignment with Upstart's Customer Identification Program (CIP), Red Flags Program, and BSA/AML compliance procedures.

• Evaluate relevant risks and typologies to develop appropriate transaction monitoring rules and efficient investigations processes

• Monitor evolving regulatory requirements, including FinCEN guidance, OFAC sanctions, and FFIEC BSA/AML examination expectations, to translate regulatory changes into scalable business processes and controls.

• Develop key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and management reporting that provide actionable insights into BSA/AML program effectiveness.

• Translate regulatory requirements and risk trends into clear recommendations for business stakeholders and senior leadership.

• Drive remediation efforts for examination, audit, monitoring, and testing findings while strengthening the overall BSA/AML compliance control environment.

Minimum Qualifications 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7+ years of experience in BSA/AML compliance, financial crimes compliance, or a related Risk or Compliance role within a bank or other regulated financial institution.

• Experience implementing and managing customer onboarding processes including identity verification, customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring processes.

• Working knowledge of regulatory requirements, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, and Customer Due Diligence Rule, and BSA/AML risks associated with deposit products

• Experience developing and delivering AML risk assessments, KRIs/KPIs, and management reporting while leading cross-functional compliance initiatives.

• Strong organizational, analytical, communication skills.

• Ability to identify gaps in policies and procedures and drive resolution and closure 

• Experience in audit and exam readiness,  including evidence gathering, testing and monitoring, addressing findings, responding to requests.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), Certified AML and Fraud Professional (CAFP), or equivalent certification.

• Experience implementing and optimizing an AML system, including data integration, rules configuration, testing, and validation.

• Experience supporting deposit products, including high-yield savings accounts, certificates of deposit, brokered deposits, or similar banking products.

• Familiarity with implementing BSA/AML tools for transaction monitoring, case management, and customer screening

• Experience working with examiners, auditors, and other third-parties.

• Knowledge of regulatory change management and implementing new BSA/AML requirements.

• Ability to investigate complex compliance issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide guidance to support issue resolution

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Time zone requirements The team operates on the East/West coast time zones. 

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
We're hiring a Self-Serve PM to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative's user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
You'll own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That includes how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There's no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.
PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.

What you'll do
• 
Own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, onboarding, lifecycle, and go-to-market levers to drive results
• 
Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows
• 
Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects
• 
Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform
• 
Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up
• 
Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product
• 
Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans
• 
Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

Requirements
• 
5+ years of product management experience on consumer or self-serve products
• 
A track record of owning revenue, growth, or adoption outcomes and driving them across multiple levers
• 
Deep familiarity with the creative space and the creators and marketers who use these tools, with a habit of bringing user insights into every product decision
• 
Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end
• 
Design-minded, with a high bar for quality and user experience and the ability to mock up concepts yourself
• 
Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on how things are built and the tradeoffs involved
• 
Strong analytical skills and comfort in product analytics tools to find opportunities and measure impact
• 
A track record of shipping quickly and iterating based on what the data shows
• 
Ownership pedigree, meaning you drive your own projects fully rather than handing off after the spec
• 
Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

df02b82ff8794687.description:
We’re a remote, product-focused startup building AI- and algorithm-driven systems, and we’re looking for a strong Backend Django Engineer who loves clean data models, well-designed APIs, and clever algorithms.

You’ll own core backend features end-to-end: from modeling the data to implementing the logic and exposing it through fast, reliable services that ship to users quickly, working with a small distributed team across several countries.

💰 $100 bonus: After successfully completing the assessment. To receive the assessment,
please submit your resume to this job application. If your resume is approved, you'll receive the
assessment afterwards.
What You’ll Do

• 
Design and implement backend servicesand APIs using Python+ Django (and DRF or similar).

• 
Model and evolve our domain in the database with clean, well-structured schemas and relationships.

• 
Implement algorithmic/AI logicin the backend (e.g., scoring, ranking, routing, decision rules).

• 
Write pragmatic, production-ready code that’s easy to reason about and iterate on.

• 
Optimize for correctness and performance: efficient queries, smart indexing, and lean responses.

• 
Work with the team to turn product ideas into concrete technical designs and endpoints.

• 
Help shape how we build things: patterns, conventions, and how we ship and iterate as we grow.

What We’re Looking For

• 
Strong experience building backend applications with Python + Django.

• 
Solid understanding of relational data modeling and SQL (we use PostgreSQL).

• 
Comfortable designing and building RESTful APIs (bonus if you’ve used DRF or similarframeworks).

• 
Experience working onnon-trivial business logic or algorithms (e.g., decision flows,scoring rules, optimization logic).

• 
Good instincts aroundperformance: understanding query behavior, avoiding obviouspitfalls, and using caching when it counts.

• 
Astartup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, moving fast, and iterating based on real-world feedback.

• 
Ability to workindependently in a remote environment and communicate clearly.

Bonus Points For

• 
Experience in startups, side projects, or hackathons where you’ve had to ship scrappy solutions fast.

• 
Background inalgorithms, optimization, or data-heavy systems.

• 
Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in production.

• 
Familiarity with Redis (caching, queues) and PostgreSQL at some scale.

• 
Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and/or serverless on GCP.

This role is a central piece of our backend roadmap, and we’re aiming to fill it quickly once we meet the right person. If it resonates with you, go ahead and apply now.
Send us your resume to start the assessment process (and get a chance at the $100 bonus).
